findings.evidence: Its statement uses only Mathlib notions, and its proof is solely `ramificationIdx_eq_one_iff` plus `Ideal.ramificationIdx_smul`; the only use in this file is as infrastructure for line 236.
findings.fix: Relocate it to the canonical ramification/Galois-action module (generalizing beyond number fields where the existing hypotheses permit) and import it here.
findings.issue: `isUnramifiedAt_pointwise_smul_iff` is general Galois-action/unramifiedness infrastructure, independent of decomposition groups or Frobenius, yet is introduced in the decomposition-group module.

findings.evidence: The theorem rewrites `Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) (τ • Q)` directly to the strictly simpler predicate at `Q`, with no reverse lemma or loop.
findings.issue: The transport equivalence is a terminating normal-form lemma but is not tagged `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot normalize unramifiedness of `τ • Q` to unramifiedness of `Q`.

summary: The decomposition-group API is otherwise coherent, but the general unramifiedness transport lemma is misplaced and lacks its normal-form automation annotation.
